boundaries.operational_receipt_change: Add bounded execution authorization witness recording consent and trusted inventory provenance; accept only after G5-03 trust and O1 plan validation, never from caller assertion alone
boundaries.target_identity: Exact consent target == recorded target == approved argv target; source-run/operation and source-class match
boundaries.evidence: At least one hash-verified same-run sealed callNNNN-stdout/stderr; D0 original evidence in same run proves target provenance; no raw edits
boundaries.privacy: Private receipt and canonical status only; no paths in public output
boundaries.timed_out_or_truncated: Existing CAPTURE_LIMIT precedence; no O1 acquisition_error reclassification when timed_out or capture_limited
boundaries.stderr: diagnostic original, not semantic health data
boundaries.health: Never infer healthy/failing from smartctl bitmask, stderr or nonzero exit
boundaries.no_new_actions: No device probes, no privilege escalation, no sudo in unit tests

positive: Valid O1 SRC-13 smartctl /dev/sdX with matching consent, same-run sealed SRC-12 inventory and stdout/stderr original, exit 2 -> PARTIAL/SOURCE_INCOMPLETE; detail retains original PARTIAL/ACQUISITION_ERROR, target and exit 2
Valid O1 SRC-13 nvme smart-log /dev/nvmeN with matching same-run namespace inventory -> partial SOURCE_INCOMPLETE with raw code retained
Registered SRC-18 and SRC-21 O1 nonzero with exact source-specific consent, plan, target and same-run D0 evidence -> same canonical mapping
All original bytes identical before and after canonical commit; manifest+receipt hashes verified; status schema still exactly 14 fields
D1 EXIT_NONZERO owner mapping unchanged; D0 and other acquisition states unchanged
negative: Missing consent / impact acknowledgement, altered ticket run/source/operation/target, untrusted target, mismatched recorded invocation, unsupported target, forged approval marker -> fail closed
No matching same-run D0 inventory evidence, fabricated inventory ID or source path, cross-run original, forged operational receipt or altered manifest -> fail closed
Missing/zero/bool/string/non-integer/out-of-bounds exit code; no original -> fail closed
Wrong auth class/source ID, wrong attempt ordinal, unsupported stream name/order, non-sealed stderr -> fail closed
Unclassified partial reason, CAPTURED with acquisition error, timeout and capture-limited precedence -> never COMPLETE/OK
Status detail must retain exact transport and code; no health derivation and no public evidence path
